ROOF REPAIR CONTRACT
Property: 123 Main St Bldg. 2, Exampletown, CA 90000
Bill To: Example Community Association c/o Sample Management, 9 Office Park, Exampletown, CA 90003

Scope of Work
- Reset and secure 3 slipped/loose tiles along sidewall at the upper roof level.
- Replace approximately 12 linear feet of flashing at the chimney.
- Clean all gutters and downspouts on the north elevation.
- Install new underlayment at the valley where the tiles are removed.

Sample Holdings Inc. dba Example Home Services (EHS) will complete the scope of work as listed above for the below signed property owner or agent, in return for the full project price as reflected above.
All surfaces to be repaired will be cleaned prior to sealing.
Debris will be removed from the site at the end of each work day.
When required, all permits will be arranged for by Example Home Services.
EHS will provide a written warranty of five (5) years on workmanship upon completion.
If any additional repairs are discovered during repairs, pricing will be discussed with client and repaired after approval.
Work will not be conducted during weekends or federal holidays, unless arrangements have been made in advance.
Any balance not paid upon completion will be charged at a rate of 1.5% per month.

The below signed property owner or agent may cancel this agreement 3 days prior to the commencement of work without penalty or loss of deposit.

Arbitration. Any dispute arising out of this contract shall be resolved by Binding Arbitration conducted by Example Dispute Resolution Services, Inc. under its rules.

NOTICE TO OWNER
Under the California Mechanics' Lien Law, any contractor, subcontractor, laborer, supplier, or other person or entity who helps to improve your property, but is not paid for his or her work or supplies, has a right to place a lien on your home, land, or property where the work was performed and to sue you in court to obtain payment.
Its purpose is to notify you of persons who may have a right to file a lien against your property.
General contractors and laborers owed wages do not have to provide this notice.

INFORMATION ABOUT THE CONTRACTORS' STATE LICENSE BOARD (CSLB)
CSLB is the state consumer protection agency that licenses and regulates construction contractors.
If you file a complaint against a licensed contractor within the legal deadline (usually four years), CSLB has authority to investigate the complaint.
